name: Yarisugi! Swimming School
original_name: やりすぎ！ スイミングスクール
source:
Borderline Swim School is a bright and slightly naughty romantic comedy! With two beautiful sisters as the main characters, their never-ending parade of naughty antics and competitions just keep coming!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037927.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
《过火！游泳学校》是一部明快又稍显色情的爱情喜剧！两名美丽姐妹担任主角，一连串淫荡恶作剧与较量接踵而至，永不停歇！

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037927.html]DLsite[/url]]
